description: Ex-Royal Danish Air Force S-55C used as a paintball prop. The Helicopter Museum's own reserve list also names S-886; survivor records place S-886 here and S-887 at the museum. Last independently noted here April 2017.
Ex-Royal Navy Hunter GA.11 coded DD-832; former naval instructional airframes A2733 and A2647. Paintball site prop.
Ex-Royal Navy Wessex HU.5, former instructional airframes A2751 and A2661. Paintball site prop.
